title: Admissions
subtitle: Would you like to join the Ingeri family? We would be delighted to welcome your child and support them through their first steps into learning, in a warm, safe environment rooted in faith.

steps.heading: Enroll my child
items: Fill out the form: follow the button to the form and we will get back to you promptly.
Schedule a visit: come discover our school, meet our team and ask your questions.
Complete the enrollment file: we will guide you through the administrative process.
Confirm your child's place: after the file has been validated.

items.q: From what age do you accept children?
items.a: At the nursery from 6 months, at kindergarten from 3 years old.

items.q: Can I visit the school before enrolling?
items.a: Yes, gladly! Contact us to arrange a visit at a time that suits you.
Fees vary by level. Please contact us directly and we will gladly send you all the information.

items.q: What documents do I need to provide?
items.a: The child's birth certificate, vaccination record, ID photos, and the completed enrollment form.

items.q: Does my child need to be Christian to be enrolled?
items.a: No, we welcome children of all faiths with respect and care.
